description: Read the error code off the single ERROR line of one night shift of an offset press journal. DISTILL-CANARY-b04a1c95

files.README.md:
# Lochee Press - press run journal

One line per press event during the night shift. Codes on ERROR lines are
the press manufacturer's fault numbers; the WARN and INFO lines carry no
codes.
